question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __principaul__ of the college announced his early retirement today.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

**The highlighted word 'principaul' is correctly spelled as 'principal'.**

 
• **The word 'principal' has two common meanings:**

 
 
• **As a noun:** The head of a school, college, or an organization. **(प्रधानाचार्य)**
